spanish: Y dijo Jehová a Moisés: ¿Hasta cuándo ustedes se niegan a guardar mis mandamientos y mis leyes?
grammarChanges: Replaced the untranslated transliteration "torás" with the Spanish common noun "leyes" for תוֹרֹתַי (feminine plural construct + 1cs suffix), matching how its companion noun מִצְוֺתַי was already rendered as "mandamientos."
